narrative.data_gaps_md:
This assessment was conducted in PUBLIC mode using 38 evidence items and 170 facts from publicly available sources (SEC filings, press releases, job postings, app store reviews, Glassdoor ratings, LinkedIn profiles, website content). Assessment confidence is HIGH for strategic and structural questions (digital strategy, leadership, governance, major technology initiatives) and MEDIUM for operational details (specific system configurations, detailed process metrics, internal staffing).
What We Could Not Assess (Requires Internal Data)
Internal technology roadmap and budget allocation
Detailed technology stack and system architecture across all business units
Internal staffing levels in technology, data science, and digital functions
Customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, and churn rates by digital channel
Real-time transaction monitoring rule set and false positive rates
Data center capacity, infrastructure costs, and disaster recovery metrics
Internal employee survey results on digital capability perceptions
Board and executive compensation tied to digital KPIs
Vendor contracts and technology partnership roadmap
Internal incident response procedures and cyber incident history (non-public)
Recommended Data for Phase 2 Assessment
To advance to a comprehensive INTERNAL assessment (adding 50-100 additional evidence items), Cathay Bank should provide: (1) Strategic technology roadmap and board-approved digital strategy, (2) Technology organization chart and staffing levels, (3) Current technology spend by category (platforms, services, infrastructure), (4) Customer analytics dashboards (acquisition cost, LTV, churn, NPS by channel), (5) Risk dashboards (fraud rates, security incidents, compliance violations), (6) Internal employee survey results and engagement metrics, (7) Vendor and partnership roadmap. With this data, assessment confidence can be elevated to VERY HIGH and scores refined to sub-decimal precision.
